senses.gloss: (b. h. טַבּוּר; טבר, cmp. טַבְלָא I) [rounded, arched,] navel, umbilicus.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 18:3">Sabb. XVIII, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 128b:13">128ᵇ</cite>) <he>את הט׳</he> the infant’s navel string.
<cite ref="Niddah 13b:35">Nidd. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>על טִבּוּרוֹ</he> (Ar. <cite ref="I00088"><he>טיב׳</he></cite>) above his navel.
<cite ref="Yoma 85a:10">Yoma 85ᵃ</cite> <he>מטיבורו</he> the formation of the embryo begins from the navel.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX; a. fr.—Trnsf. centre or highest part.
<cite ref="Megillah 6a:4">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> (homiletic etymol. of <cite ref="I00088"><he>טבריה</he></cite>) <he>שיושבת בטִיבּוּרָהּ של א״י</he> it is situated on the height of Palestine.
